mechanisms.cell_missingness: Artificial MCAR: independent Bernoulli masks, separate RNG from numeric DGP, retained rows only scored.
mechanisms.calendar_deletion: Independent Bernoulli deletion within seven non-late-entry scenarios; all mask draws precede retention decisions.
mechanisms.structural_missingness: Four late-entry entities are deterministically unobserved before period9; separate from MCAR masks.
mechanisms.new_categories_text: Artificial schema/vocabulary changes after period35; not numeric outcome events.

evaluation_policy.truth_usage: Evaluation only after fitting/method choice; truth values never supplied to cleaners or profiles.
evaluation_policy.event_matching: Same entity and activity; one-to-one exact/nearest/earliest; one true persistent event per affected entity.
